cards.name: Stop Defense
cards.description: Forces an opponent's monster card positioned for defense into the attack position.

cards.name: Dragon Capture Jar
cards.description: Destroys all opponent Dragon monsters on the playfield!

cards.name: Forest
cards.description: Changes the field in favor of Beast-Warrior, Insect, Plant and Beast monsters!

cards.name: Wasteland
cards.description: Changes the field in favor of Zombie, Dinosaur and Rock monsters!

cards.name: Mountain
cards.description: Changes the field in favor of Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder monsters!

cards.name: Sogen
cards.description: Changes the field to meadow land in favor of Warrior and Beast-Warrior monsters!

cards.name: Umi
cards.description: Changes the field in favor of Aqua and Thunder monsters, but unfavorable to Machine and Pyro monsters!

cards.name: Yami
cards.description: Changes the field in favor of Magic-User and Fiend monsters, but unfavorable to Fairy monsters!

cards.name: Dark Hole
cards.description: Sucks up every card in play on the field!

cards.name: Raigeki
cards.description: Destroy every opposing monster with a stroke of lightning!

cards.name: Mooyan Curry
cards.description: A delicious beef curry increases Life Points by 200!

cards.name: Red Medicine
cards.description: A magic potion that increases Life Points by 500!

cards.name: Goblin's Secret Remedy
cards.description: A goblin's herb that increases Life Points by 1000!

cards.name: Soul of the Pure
cards.description: A fairy potion that increases Life Points by 2000!

cards.name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
cards.description: A mystical power that increases Life Points by 5000!

cards.name: Sparks
cards.description: A shower of sparks inflicts 50 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points!

cards.name: Hinotama
cards.description: A fireball inflicts 100 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points!

cards.name: Final Flame
cards.description: A flame inflicts 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points!

cards.name: Ookazi
cards.description: A flame inflicts 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points!

cards.name: Tremendous Fire
cards.description: An inferno inflicts 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points!

cards.name: Swords of Revealing Light
cards.description: Enemy monsters are revealed and your opponent cannot attack for three turns.

cards.name: Spellbinding Circle
cards.description: A curse reduces the power of all enemy monsters!

cards.name: Dark-piercing Light
cards.description: A dazzling light reveals all monsters on the playing field.

cards.name: Warrior Elimination
cards.description: Destroys all opponent Warrior cards played on the field.

cards.name: Cursebreaker
cards.description: Cancels the magic over all level-reduced monsters and sets them at level 0.

cards.name: Eternal Rest
cards.description: Eliminates all Zombie creatures.

cards.name: Stain Storm
cards.description: Acid rain destroys an opponent's Machine monsters.

cards.name: Crush Card
cards.description: Opponent monsters in play with attack factors of 1500 or more are eliminated.

cards.name: Eradicating Aerosol
cards.description: An insecticide for wiping out an opponent's Insect monsters that are currently in play.

cards.name: Breath of Light
cards.description: A magic wind that reduces to rubble an opponent's Rock monsters that are currently in play.

cards.name: Eternal Draught
cards.description: A blast of heat dries up and eliminates an opponent's Fish monsters that are currently in play.

cards.name: Shadow Spell
cards.description: Decreases an opponent's in-play monsters by two levels.

cards.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
cards.description: Destroy all opponent Magic Cards that are in play.
